label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
To the residents of Larkspur Lofts,

I am writing to address the note recently posted in the lobby about a drone seen near the building, and to explain what I was actually doing.

I have lived in Unit 5A for three years. On Saturday, October 31, at about 4 p.m., I flew a new drone from the roof deck for roughly 11 minutes. It was a Halvard Mini 4, and I was testing it before using it at a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge for the entire flight. It was not pointed at any windows, and I did not record anyone inside the building.

I understand that a drone hovering over the courtyard could look strange or unsettling, especially to people who did not know what it was. I am sorry that it worried residents, including neighbors’ grandchildren who saw it. That was not my intention.

At the same time, the note in the lobby referred to me as a “creep” and included my unit number. I want to be honest that this felt like being publicly identified and accused, and it was upsetting. I am not writing to argue about who posted it. I am asking that if anyone has a concern about something I am doing, they please come speak with me directly rather than leave an anonymous note.

I am happy to show anyone the full, unedited footage from the flight. You can knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

Our HOA rules do not currently address drones. I will not fly from the roof again until the board decides whether to adopt a rule, and I will ask the board to add this to the agenda for the November 19 meeting at 7 p.m. in the community room. I hope this clarifies things, and I am glad to talk with any neighbor.

Sincerely,
Jess Okafor
Unit 5A
